name: Khiva
tagline: A walled Silk Road city frozen in time
summary: Khiva's inner town, Itchan Kala, is a perfectly preserved walled city of mud-brick ramparts, turquoise minarets, madrasas and palaces. Walk the walls at sunset, climb the Islam Khodja minaret, see the stunted Kalta Minor, and explore the ruined desert fortresses of ancient Khorezm nearby.
seasonNote: Spring and autumn; summers are extremely hot and winters cold.
arrival: Trains from Bukhara (about 6 to 7 hours) and high-speed links via Urgench; flights to Urgench airport, 30 minutes away.
gettingAround: Walk Itchan Kala; car for desert fortresses.
cashTip: Carry som in cash; cards are growing in cities but not everywhere. Tip about 10 percent.
foodTip: Shivit oshi (green dill noodles), tukhum barak (egg dumplings) and plov.
buyTip: Silk carpets, carved wooden doors and suzani embroidery.

connections.note: Trains and cars across the desert.
